header: THE DATABASE SIDE OF THE SEARCH INDEX (src/lib/nl2sql/sql/29_announcement_search_index.sql). I take the same care as admin/files.ts: every READ is wrapped in a savepoint, so a database where the tables are not there yet (the SQL file not run, and nothing indexed yet) simply has no index: announcements, their PDFs and their literal search are untouched. I keep two PARTS apart, so that one can be redone without the other: the BODY (source 'body' passages) and the PDF (source 'pdf' passages, its page pictures, its text). Each has its own state in announcement_index. The functions that REPLACE a part return the addresses of the page pictures it had, for the caller to delete from storage after the commit.

symbols.name: dropPdfIndex
symbols.sig: export async function dropPdfIndex(q: QueryFn, id: number): Promise<string[]>
doc: I remove everything the PDF part holds for an announcement (its PDF was removed or replaced) and leave the body part alone. Returns the page pictures it had. Missing tables are fine.

symbols.sig: export async function savePdfIndex(q: QueryFn, id: number, o: { chunks: IndexedChunk[]; text: string; pages: number; textPages: number; ocrPages: number; note: string | null; pageUrls: Map<number, string> }): Promise<string[]>

params.name: o
params.type: { chunks: IndexedChunk[]; text: string; pages: number; textPages: number; ocrPages: number; note: string | null; pageUrls: Map<number, string> }

doc: I replace the PDF part with a freshly read one, taking its passages, page pictures and text together. Returns the page pictures it had before.

symbols.name: savePdfFailure
symbols.sig: export async function savePdfFailure(q: QueryFn, id: number, note: string): Promise<string[]>
doc: Records that the PDF could not be read. I drop what an older PDF left, because it belonged to a PDF that is no longer there. Returns the page pictures it had.

symbols.name: saveBodyIndex
symbols.sig: export async function saveBodyIndex(q: QueryFn, id: number, o: { chunks: IndexedChunk[] }): Promise<void>
doc: Replaces the body part: the passages of the announcement's own text. No chunks (an empty body) clears it.

symbols.name: saveBodyFailure
symbols.sig: export async function saveBodyFailure(q: QueryFn, id: number, note: string): Promise<void>
doc: Records that the body's passages could not be made. I keep the old ones (they are the previous text's) because the literal search and the whole-record vector still serve; the state says it.

symbols.name: indexStateOf
symbols.sig: export async function indexStateOf(q: QueryFn, ids: number[]): Promise<Map<number, IndexState>>
doc: The state of the index of these announcements; with a missing table I return none of them.

symbols.name: pageUrlsOf
symbols.sig: export async function pageUrlsOf(q: QueryFn, id: number): Promise<string[]>
doc: The page pictures of an announcement, used when deleting it: the pictures go from storage after the commit, and the rows go by cascade. A missing table gives none.
